item.title: Key Takeaways from the National Conference on Strengthening Panchayat Audit Systems
item.description:
Key Takeaways from the National Conference on Strengthening Panchayat Audit Systems

The Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), in collaboration with the Comptroller and Auditor General (C&AG), conducted a national-level deliberation to improve the audit ecosystem of Rural Local Bodies (RLBs). The discussions focused on improving accountability, transparency, digital audit systems, Action Taken Reports (ATRs), and strengthening the institutional capacity of Local Fund Audit Departments.

This article summarizes the major deliberations, recommendations, and action points that emerged from the conference.

item.title: Building a High-Speed Parallel Bookmarklet Scraper for eGramSwaraj and Sikkim LFA Portals
item.description:
Deep-Dive Engineering: Scraping Government Accounting Portals at Scale

Extracting local governance financial data from Indian public portals—such as eGramSwaraj and the Sikkim Local Fund Audit (LFA)—presents a unique set of technical hurdles. Web developers working with these portals frequently run into multi-layer redirects (FileRedirect.jsp), inconsistent page structures, deeply nested HTML tables, dynamic query string parameters, and server-side rate constraints.

When scraping thousands of voucher reports across dynamic financial years, standard browser extensions or sequential script implementations often fall short. They either take several hours to complete, crash due to syntax edge cases, or output mislabeled files due to poor metadata extraction logic.

item.title: Building an Automated eGramSwaraj Data Extractor: Streamlining Municipal Audit Workflows
item.description:
Building an Automated eGramSwaraj Data Extractor: Streamlining Municipal Audit Workflows

Introduction

Conducting financial audits across local governance bodies—such as Gram Panchayats and Urban Local Bodies—often presents a classic data management bottleneck: portals like eGramSwaraj house thousands of crucial expenditure vouchers, payment records, and development scheme allocations, but extracting this data into structured formats for audit sampling can be tedious and prone to manual error.

To solve this, we developed a lightweight, client-side JavaScript extraction script that hooks directly into the browser DOM while inspecting eGramSwaraj data views. This tool automates the aggregation of voucher numbers, dates, beneficiary details, payment amounts, and scheme heads, exporting everything into clean, standardized CSV files ready for audit analysis.
